# Collaborative Intelligence and Anicca iOS error recovery

Official manifest audit: 160 released scenarios, seven NC and three encrypted; Lite 40 contains one NC and three encrypted. Unflagged does not mean rights cleared. Native matched evaluation delegated #755, no model score or training. Actual Anicca Swift cache validation on decoded fictional API inputs improved 2/16 to 16/16; rejects malformed times and preserves valid siblings. Product #961 stacked on #959; Xcode/device/release pending.

[Evidence](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-ops/pull/756) · [iOS patch](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-products/pull/961)

Sources: [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02633), [official harness](https://github.com/zou-group/collaborative-intelligence), [Ampersand](https://ampersand.humansand.ai/blog/).
